description: This file defines a utility class LendingStrategyEnumerations that provides methods to obtain EnumOptionData instances corresponding to different LendingStrategy enum values. It facilitates conversion from integer or enum types to a standardized data representation for use elsewhere in the project.

classes.name: LendingStrategyEnumerations
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for converting LendingStrategy enum values into EnumOptionData objects.

methods.name: lendingStrategy
methods.description: Converts an Integer ID to an EnumOptionData representing the corresponding LendingStrategy.

methods.name: lendingStrategy
methods.description: Converts a LendingStrategy enum value to an EnumOptionData with descriptive text.
